The surface texture is smooth and painted (likely fiberglass or concrete), lacking biological skin details. Visible construction seams are present at the leg joints and belly. checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder height is visibly lower than the hip height, creating the characteristic downward slope of the back towards the neck.
The tail tapers quickly from the body and does not extend far past the hindlegs, fitting the 'short and stout' description.
